guide.summary: Public app, your own OAuth app (approval path unconfirmed). Where the path is unconfirmed, the agent did not find it in the provider's docs.

composio.note: Harvest is listed as Composio-managed OAuth. For production, create a custom auth config with your own client ID and secret.

need_own_app.answer: Not for a prototype, because Composio provides a managed Harvest app. For production you will likely want your own, so users see your app name and you get dedicated quota.
reasons: Consent screen shows your app name instead of Composio
Dedicated quota instead of quota shared across all Composio users

scenarios.label: Public app, your own OAuth app
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your agent product connects many customers' Harvest accounts through your own OAuth2 app.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured

waiting.basis: No review or approval wait was found in the dossier (G6 not found).

scenarios.approval: No provider review is documented. You register an OAuth2 app in Harvest ID. Whether review applies before outside customers connect is unconfirmed.

prerequisites.title: Harvest account with admin rights
prerequisites.detail: Registering an app required being logged in as an Administrator (per the older v1 docs). Current docs say apps are created in the Developers section of Harvest ID.

prerequisites.title: Pick the minimal product scope
prerequisites.detail: The app's Products setting is Harvest, Forecast or both. Harvest advises the minimal scope that works.

steps.title: Copy redirect URI from Composio dashboard
steps.detail: Get the callback URL from the Composio dashboard for the Harvest toolkit.
steps.done_when: You have the redirect URI string.

steps.title: Create OAuth2 app in Harvest ID
steps.detail: In the Developers section of Harvest ID, create the application with name, redirect URI and product scope.
steps.done_when: Harvest shows a client ID and secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom Harvest auth config through Composio's API with your client ID and secret.

steps.title: Test a connection with another user
steps.detail: Connect a Harvest account from outside your own organization and confirm the consent screen shows your app name.

traps.title: Old docs are deprecated v1
traps.detail: Registration pages at harvestapp.com belong to the deprecated V1 API. Use the Harvest ID Developers flow for V2.

traps.title: Rate limits apply to the account
traps.detail: General requests are limited to 100 per 15 seconds, and Reports to 100 per 15 minutes. Exceeding them blocks the account.

traps.title: Managed app shares quota and shows Composio
traps.detail: With the managed app, quota is shared across Composio users and consent shows Composio's name.

open_questions: Does Harvest review public OAuth apps before outside customers can connect? Check with Harvest support or test with a non-owned account.
How long does any Harvest approval take? No wait time was found; ask Harvest support.
Does a customer's Harvest admin need to approve your app? The docs describe none; confirm with a test account.
Which exact redirect URI rules does Harvest enforce, such as domain verification? Check the Harvest ID app form.

claims.quote:
### Header authentication example

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN " \
-H "Harvest-Account-Id: $ACCOUNT_ID " \
-H "User-Agent: MyApp ( [email protected] )" \
https://api.harvestapp.com/v2/users/me

### Query string authentication example

curl -H "User-Agent: MyApp ( [email protected] )" \
"https://api.harvestapp.com/v2/users/me?access_token= $ACCESS_TOKEN &account_id= $ACCOUNT_ID "

## OAuth2 application

If you are interested in building integrations that other users can use, you will need to register an OAuth2 Application, also
known as an OAuth2 Client.
